locations.note: Sam lives in peaceful isolation near the former US–Mexico border until Fragile asks him to connect northern Mexico to the Chiral Network; Deadman's recording leads him to a plate gate in southern Mexico.

Through the plate gate aboard the tar ship DHV Magellan, Sam crosses Australia from the south-west through the Northern Territory to the east coast, connecting its survivors while Higgs's ghost mechs besiege the settlements.

routes.name: Sam Porter Bridges
routes.note: Mexico first, then through the plate gate to Australia.
